title: Clerk notched band
description: A full-width dark band whose top and bottom edges step in with 45° shoulders, so the light sections above and below appear to dip into it like tabs. Wrap any section content in it.
notes: tone="dark" (default) adds the dark class; set edgeTop/edgeBottom to the colour of the neighbouring sections so the notches show it
the notches line up with the content column (page width minus gutters)
name: clerk-band

props.name: notchTop
props.description: step the top edge in (the section above dips into the band)

props.name: notchBottom
props.description: step the bottom edge in (the section below rises into the band)

props.name: edgeTop
props.description: colour of the section above, shown inside the top notch

props.name: edgeBottom
props.description: colour of the section below, shown inside the bottom notch

props.name: tone
props.description: dark forces the dark colours (as on the original); inherit follows the page
